Alysia, saw Stayntouch get picked as Sonesta's preferred PMS and named 2025 Hotel PMS of the Year.

Wins like that usually open more in-market properties than the Northeast team can cover, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Stayntouch off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Alysia, quick follow-up for Stayntouch.

With new flag wins driving demand, the regional pipeline target usually outpaces what the team can cover. Most directors cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many Northeast property meetings you need this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Alysia, last bit of proof for Stayntouch.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other hospitality-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
